system.description: Beginning at 6th level, your training has led you down a path unexplored by many. You have made it your job to become the most well-prepared Shinobi in any room you stand in. Select any two maneuvers from the following Scout-Nin subclasses, adding them to your Maneuvers known, not counting it against your known maneuvers limit. You cannot take a maneuver with the Specialized keyword from another subclass. You can select an additional +2 at 14th level; Arbiter Scout, Assault Scout, Cloning Scout, Elemental Scout, Phantom Scout.
